parole.significato: lees, dregs, grounds (the sediment that settles during fermentation of wine)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Volga Bulgar *čöpräɣ, before the times of the Hungarian conquest of the Carpathian Basin (at the turn of the 9th and 10th centuries). Cognate with Chuvash ҫӗпре (śĕpre). Compare Bashkir сүпрә (süprä, “leaven, ferment”), Greek τσίπουρο (tsípouro).

Borrowed from Volga Bulgar *sywyr (compare modern Chuvash сӑвӑр (săvăr, “to sprinkle, scatter”)), before the times of the Hungarian conquest of the Carpathian Basin (at the turn of the 9th and 10th centuries).

parole.significato: artemisia (any of many aromatic flowering plants of the genus Artemisia)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Volga Bulgar *ärmä. Compare to Chuvash эрӗм (erĕm, “wormwood”), also compare to Kazakh изен (ıyzen).
